source_segments.text: Gerhard Meidell Gerhardsen (1848–1912) Gerhard Meidell Gerhardsen (9 July 1848 – 25 July 1912) was a Norwegian bailiff and politician for the Conservative Party.
He was born at the farm Roalstvedt in Kvinnherred as a son of Clement Gerhardsen and Mette Dorthea Haavig.
He worked as acting bailiff in Føyen from 1871 to 1872, and bailiff in Finnaas from 1872.
From 1874 he was a member of the municipal council.
He was also chairman of the savings bank Moster Sparebank, and worked as a farmer and school teacher.
He was elected to the Parliament of Norway in 1892.
